formula: On-policy surrogate at ratio1: per-token loss derivative coefficient = -sum_i advantage_i/(K*response_length_i). Sum advantages0 alone does not cancel common-prefix derivatives when response lengths differ.
limitations: Exact saved lengths/advantages/prefixes; no new model call or training.
This is an expected sequence-mean property, not a confirmed GSPO formula bug.
Shared prefixes have identical mathematical causal contexts; native per-token gradients and dominance were not independently measured.
Remainder from label projection also includes nonclass label text and is not format-only.
